correctness.rationale: Reconstructed definitions: valid orientations have positive indegree everywhere and DOM_t maximizes directed total domination over valid orientations. On a cyclic orientation of chorded C_m+leaf, each cycle vertex is essential as unique in-neighbor of an appropriate other vertex; all cycle vertices dominate in every admissible orientation, yielding m. Deleting c3 creates a connected unicyclic graph with exactly two leaves; all valid orientations follow directed cycle/outward trees and DOM_t equals m-2. For n<=5, noncycle parent has DOM_t<=n-1 and admissible child has DOM_t>=3, giving gap<=1. Independent graph atlas calculation of ALL 156 six-vertex unlabeled graphs, valid orientations and marked orbits reconstructed exactly 18 classes, 9000 labeled marked pairs and 5850 labeled underlying graphs; brute force family m5..7 matched.

evidence: 2024 classification of parent DOM_t(G)=|V|-1 covers the first parent value; 2023 unicyclic formula covers the child value.
